versions.summary: Baseline: recommended default Claude Code config + release state (CLI v2.1.162, Opus 4.8), tips, hacks, starter settings.json/CLAUDE.md.

Two new default models (Sonnet 5 in v2.1.197, Opus 5 in v2.1.219); base permission mode renamed 'Manual' (v2.1.200); subagents background-by-default + Claude in Chrome GA + /dataviz (v2.1.198); auto mode without opt-in on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry (v2.1.207); /config key=value, Tool(param:value) rules, screen reader mode. CLI now v2.1.223.

Infrastructure-focused period, no new models. Self-hosted runners via `claude self-hosted-runner` (v2.1.224, Team/Enterprise); cross-session SendMessage across machines with ListAgents (v2.1.224), extended to start Remote Control conversations by name (v2.1.225); archive plugin source with SHA-256 pinning (v2.1.224); crossSessionInbound/dialogExpiry settings (v2.1.224); ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX and sandbox credential-masking (v2.1.224); 200-subagent-per-session cap removed (v2.1.224); claude agents workspace-trust prompt + gateway spend-limit surfacing (v2.1.225). CLI now v2.1.226.

No new models, but several default-behavior/config changes (v2.1.227-v2.1.233). Subagent forking on by default: subagent_type:'fork' inherits full conversation + prompt cache, non-teammate spawns background-by-default (v2.1.232). Task/todo tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) removed on Opus 4.8/Sonnet 5/Fable 5/Mythos 5 and newer models; CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 to restore (v2.1.233). @-mention another session + bare-name SendMessage + unique per-machine names (v2.1.232). Broad GitLab support: plugin marketplaces incl. nested subgroups + token redaction (v2.1.232), MR URLs in --worktree/claude agents as !N (v2.1.233). Write tool matches Edit overwrite rules for newer models (v2.1.228). /code-review high/xhigh/max background (v2.1.232). Plugin marketplace command sources (v2.1.229). New /config rows + additionalMarketplaces/allowedMarketplaces aliases (v2.1.232). Nested-repo trust (v2.1.232). Tighter /commit-push-pr defaults (v2.1.229). CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT/WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS/WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS env vars. CLI now v2.1.233.

No new models; a wave of new settings/env vars/defaults (v2.1.234-v2.1.241). ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL env var sets the starting model softly (yields to /model pick and to a file model key), unlike ANTHROPIC_MODEL (v2.1.236). Built-in 'Concise' output style (v2.1.237). Auto-continue session when claude.ai usage limit resets, toggle in /config (v2.1.234). spellcheck setting via aspell/hunspell/ispell (v2.1.235). keybindingFlavor:'readline' for Bash-style word keys (v2.1.238/239). Plugin-marketplace headersHelper mints short-lived HTTP auth headers with trust/credential isolation (v2.1.238). Windows cross-session messaging + notify_when_idle on SendMessage (v2.1.236/239). Self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min and --proxy-authorization-command/file (v2.1.238). Auto-mode classifier parity on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry + Monitor reviewed like Bash (v2.1.236). CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME + GitLab MR badge + 'Default teammate model' removed + mid-turn /permissions & /add-dir (v2.1.234). Cost estimates include 1.1x US-only-inference premium; /claude-api upgrade for anthropic 0.x->1.x; cloud plugins name@synced (v2.1.239). NTLM NT-namespace path hardening (v2.1.234) + macOS sandbox wildcard read-deny precedence (v2.1.236). v2.1.240/241 bugfix-only. CLI now v2.1.241. Sonnet 5 reviewed: pass (all claims verified, no corrections).

Model-default change + a substantial security batch (v2.1.245-v2.1.251). Seat-based Enterprise subscriptions now default to Opus 5, matching other premium plans (v2.1.251) - no new model shipped. New PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch hook events (block/confirm/annotate a model switch) + SessionStart resume hooks receive session staleness and re-cache cost (v2.1.251). New --restricted / CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1 locked-down mode: drops command/code tools + WebFetch, confines file tools to the working dir, refuses bypassPermissions, ignores settings files (v2.1.248). Per-agent experimental.cacheTtl frontmatter (v2.1.248). CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL softened to a default that per-agent/per-spawn models override (v2.1.251). SendFeedback tool + feedbackDrafts setting (v2.1.247). Auto-mode tab in /permissions (v2.1.246) + one-keystroke switch-to-auto-mode on Bash prompts (v2.1.247). /claude-api cost-optimize + Admin API coverage (v2.1.247). Prompt-cache line in /cost + prompt_cache status-line object; Spend-limit bar in /usage + rate_limits.spend_limit (v2.1.251). claude attach <id> + attach/logs/stop/respawn/rm in --help (v2.1.251). /effort saved per model; Opus 5 effort xhigh/max with thinking off sends effort=high (v2.1.251). Sonnet 5 auto-compacts on full 1M window (~967K) (v2.1.247). Broad file-access/sandbox hardening: Read/Write/Edit symlink-swap TOCTOU fix, Grep/Glob honor Read deny rules through symlinks, plugin-command path-traversal rejection, project settings can't enable beta tracing/raw logging, project env can't set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/TMPDIR, ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS + sandbox-weakening managed settings require approval (v2.1.251). /usage-credits for Enterprise (AWS Marketplace/self-serve/trials), same-machine cross-session messaging on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, /loop dynamic+autonomous always available (v2.1.248). Workflow tool description ~5.7k->~1k tokens + workflow-authoring skill (v2.1.248). Removed syntax highlighting for six langs; binary ~5MB smaller (v2.1.251). v2.1.245 (glibc 2.44 crash fix) & v2.1.250 bugfix-only. CLI now v2.1.251. Sonnet 5 reviewed: pass (all claims verified against v2.1.245-v2.1.251 release bodies + hooks docs, no corrections).
